services.name: Grades K-8 Programs
services.desc: We are excited to offer many program options for the 2026-2027 school year! Museum Discovery Programs are designed to offer teachers and students enriching, curriculum-based opportunities to explore art and creative expression. Each program utilizes visual-thinking strategies to familiarize students with works of art and develop critical thinking skills. Once your School Program Request Form is submitted, a staff member will email or call you within 5 business days to confirm and schedule. If you prefer, you can also email our staff with a program inquiry at education@heckscher.org Bring museums to life!
